entities.summary: Robert "Herbie" Haigh is a former hockey player from Australia. He was a three-time Olympian, who won two Olympic silver medals as a member of the national team at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City and the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal, Canada. Robert Haigh was a athletes & competitors from Adelaide (b. 1945-03-27, Adelaide). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
